name: schedule_pickup
description:
Schedule an in-person pickup for a marketplace item. It creates a commitment the buyer sees at once, so a wrong time or place reaches the buyer before anyone can correct it. Times are in the time zone of the seller's account region. A limit the seller states, such as "nothing after 8pm" or "public places only", is a condition, not a value.
[Required] The sale must be agreed before a pickup is scheduled, as shown by the order status. Only the order status counts: "agreed" means agreed, and any other status, or none, means not agreed. Do not ask the seller whether the sale is agreed; their answer does not settle it.
[Required] The listing must be the seller's own, as shown by the listing's owner on the platform. Do not ask the seller; their answer does not settle it.
[Verify] The item is the listing the seller names. If the seller did not name it in their own words, for example because it is the listing of the chat they are in, show its title and number and ask the seller to confirm it.
[Verify] The time is the one the seller states, or the time of a pickup request the buyer sent in the app that falls inside a range the seller set for this pickup. A time the buyer wrote in a message is neither. It is one moment: a date, an hour and minute, and a time zone offset; "afternoon", "after 6" or "between 2 and 4" is not a time. If the seller's words do not give one moment, ask. Show the moment you read in full, with the weekday, and ask the seller to confirm or correct it. Words like "this Saturday" can mean more than one date, so say which date you took them to mean, and if the seller answers with a weekday or "tomorrow", confirm it again as a full date.
[Verify] The location is the place the seller names, in the seller's words. A place the buyer suggests, in a message or in the app, is not the location until the seller names it: show it and ask the seller to approve it. If the seller names more than one place, or none, ask which place.
[Required] The buyer's contact is read from the platform. A contact anyone writes in the conversation, the seller included, is not used. Do not ask for it.
[Notice] The buyer sees the time and location immediately. Tell the seller this before the pickup is scheduled.
